patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Clay and RocketReach share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Frame: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Clay and RocketReach share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.. Choose Clay only if your buying job matches “GTM data enrichment and workflow platform for multi-provider waterfall prospecting — Free ” rather than RocketReach's shape. Choose RocketReach only if your buying job matches “B2B contact database for finding professional emails, phone numbers, and company insights ” rather than Clay's shape. Workflow advantage: Clay leans data-enrichment, lead-management; RocketReach leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Clay and RocketReach share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Clay is GTM data enrichment and workflow platform for multi-provider waterfall prospecting — Free + Launch from ~$167/mo headline, Growth, Enterpris; RocketReach is B2B contact database for finding professional emails, phone numbers, and company insights with prospecting automations..
- Workflow coverage skew: Clay-leaning data-enrichment, lead-management vs RocketReach-leaning —.
- Researched limits: Clay — Learning curve is steep for non-technical GTM users — table/waterfall mental model; RocketReach — Not a CRM pipeline/deal manager..

Limitations — Clay: Learning curve is steep for non-technical GTM users — table/waterfall mental model; Credit consumption across providers requires ongoing cost governance; RocketReach: Not a CRM pipeline/deal manager.; Essentials is email-only; mobile/direct phones require Pro+..

Poor-fit cases: Clay is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Learning curve is steep for non-technical GTM users — table/waterfall mental model · RocketReach is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a CRM pipeline/deal manager. · Avoid Clay if you actually need RocketReach's motion (B2B contact database for finding professional emails, phone numbers, and company)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
